name: BOGO Same Product (Buy One Get One Free)
author: Virtualcode

sections.description:
BOGO Same Product allows you to run Buy One Get One Free promotions in WooCommerce.

When an eligible product is added to the cart, its quantity is automatically doubled while the customer only pays for half.
The plugin supports simple, variable, and grouped products and respects sale pricing.

Features

  • Buy One Get One Free on the same product
  • Apply to all products or selected products only
  • Works with simple, variable, and grouped products
  • Sale prices are supported automatically
  • Free items are clearly labeled in the cart and checkout
  • Clean and modern admin interface
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin through the WordPress Plugins menu
  3. Go to WooCommerce → BOGO Same Product to configure
sections.faq:
Can I apply this to only certain products?

Yes, you can choose to apply BOGO to all products or only selected ones.

Will this work with variable products?

Yes, both variations and parent products are supported.

How does pricing work?

Customers receive one free item for each item purchased.
